items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

ctx.x: He always saw it that way. And many of the great sessions were produced on that basis.

Exciting. I saw Benny Carter do the same thing with Joe Newman, and Cat Anderson. You wouldn’t think that that duo would do it, but it’s one of the most exciting things you ever want to hear. The Japanese went crazy.
